title: Referral Request Checklist
subtitle: Capture referral source, requested service, supporting record, and receiving provider; confirm appointment and result return.
description: Referral Request records referral source, requested service, supporting record, receiving provider, appointment, and result return. Referral Request evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this referral request stage-gated verification when staff must document referral source and requested service. Reconcile supporting record, receiving provider, appointment, and result return before the referral request handoff. Use the request source, reason and requested specialty, records checklist, preferred-provider directory result, capacity response, appointment notice, and closed-loop report. Ask the assigned referral request reviewer to confirm referral source against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Referral Request contact and reference
sections.guidance: Capture referral source, requested service and reason, urgency, supporting documents, preferred receiving provider, scheduling constraints, appointment, and result return. Keep any urgent referral request issue with its escalation contact and time.

sections.title: Referral Request checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current referral request facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Referral Request required checks
items: Referral source is identified for this record
Requested service matches the current request or source
Supporting record is ready for point-of-use staff
Receiving provider limits or questions are resolved
Appointment is communicated to the responsible person
Result return is confirmed at handoff
A changed referral request fact is returned for review

blocks.label: Referral Request failed or pending items

sections.title: Referral Request readiness and handoff
sections.guidance: Hold referral request readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Referral Request reviewer receipt
blocks.guidance: Referral Request receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
